high_level_description: This image captures a serene beach scene during sunset. The sun is low on the horizon, casting a warm, golden glow over the entire landscape. The sky transitions from a soft yellow near the sun to a lighter, almost white hue as it extends upward. In the foreground, there is a person standing on the sandy beach, facing away from the camera towards the ocean. The individual has long, dark hair tied back with a hair clip, and they are wearing a white tank top and light blue denim shorts. A tattoo is visible on their upper arm.
